subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as a first-class qwen plugin provider via the linked PR, or keep this plan outside the official qwen provider surface for now?
rationale: The request is not a broken existing contract; it adds a new provider id, auth choices, env var, endpoints, and catalog surface, which the repository policy treats as product and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Review the linked provider PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94419 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide whether it should be repaired and landed in the qwen plugin.

options.title: Reject bundled provider surface
options.body: Close the linked PR and keep Token Plan users on custom provider config or an external plugin/ClawHub path until maintainer demand or official evidence changes.

options.title: Ask for a narrower surface
options.body: Limit the work to docs, custom-config guidance, or SDK/plugin seams instead of adding new bundled provider/auth choices now.

recommendation.title: Review the linked provider PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94419 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide whether it should be repaired and landed in the qwen plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced and later adjusted the qwen provider owner boundary that the requested surface extends.
